full_judgment: 2. The facts as stated in the petition, in short, are, that the late Haris Ahmed, husband of opposite party No.6, instituted Title Suit No. 34 of 1989 in the court of Upazila Assistant Judge praying for the declaration that he was entitled to get a deed of reconveyance from the petitioner on payment of Taka 5835.00 which was calculated after deducting two and a half years usufruct. The suit land comprises of an area of 0.24 decimals of land of plot No. 95 under Khatian No. 4 of Mouza Afzarkhil within Police Station Chatkhail. The owner, Haris Ahmed transferred the land to the defendant by a registered kabala on 15th Falgoon 1391 BS corresponding to 27.2.85 AD at a consideration of Taka 35.000.00 subject to a contemporaneous agreement for reconveyance. At the time of execution of the agreement the vendee promised to reconvey the land in favour of the vendor at any time within February 1988 on receipt of the kabala consideration. The plaintiff tendered the consideration money and demanded for reconveyance repeatedly but the defendant did not honour the agreement and on 2.8.87 finally declined to reconvey the land. Hence the suit for redemption of mortgage. The plaintiff sought relief under President's Order 88 of 1972 and President's Order 136 of 1972 and also President's Order 24 of 1972 and paid court fee of Taka 30.00 and the suit was valued at Taka 5835.00 on the ground that an mount of Taka 29,165.00 has been adjusted since 27.2.85 by way of enjoyment of usufruct of the land.
